paragraphs.text:
You take first watch that night, while the others sleep after an 
exhausting day. The brief darkness is disturbed by the splash of 
beavers in the stream, the trilling of insects, and the hoot of a 
great gray owl.
Make a Listen roll: if you succeed, go to 9; if you fail, go to 8.
